szoveg_eredeti:
Conference chair Peter Chin talks about artificial intelligence and human judgment.

Dartmouth is hosting the AI at 70: What Must Remain? conference on Oct. 29-31, and Professor of Engineering Peter Chin, the conference chair, says issues of human judgment and discernment will be a big part of the conversation.
